name: The Parent Trap
desc: The 1998 film The Parent Trap: the twins, the camp, the swap, Meredith, and who said which line. Hard, and no questions about the actors.

100: At which summer camp in Maine do the twins meet?
Camp Walden
In which city does Annie live with her mother?
London
In which California wine region does Hallie live with her father?
Napa Valley
Which snack do both twins love: which biscuit, dipped in what?
Oreos dipped in peanut butter
What do the twins put together that proves they're sisters?
Two halves of a torn photo of their parents
What is the name of Annie's family butler in London?
Martin
What is the name of Nick's housekeeper and nanny?
Chessy
What do the twins agree to do at the end of camp to meet the parent they've never known?
Swap places
What does Hallie's father do for a living?
He owns a vineyard (makes wine)
What does Annie's mother do for a living?
She designs wedding dresses
Which fruit are both twins allergic to?
Strawberries
Which card game do the twins play at camp, with a bet on who has to jump in the lake?
Poker
Which twin flies to London pretending to be her sister?
Hallie
After the final camping-trip prank, where does Meredith wake up?
Floating on her air mattress in the middle of the lake
Who is Nick engaged to when Annie arrives in California as Hallie?
Meredith Blake
Who says it? "We have a butler?"
Hallie
200: What is the name of the cabin the twins are sent to as a punishment?
Besides cutting her hair, what does Hallie do to Annie so she can pass as Hallie?
The twins first come face to face at the end of a match in which sport?
On which ship did Nick and Elizabeth get married?
What is the twins' mother's first name?
What is the twins' father's first name?
Meredith says that once she marries Nick, she'll ship the girls off to which country?
Meredith tells Nick "It's me or them." How does he answer?
Who at Nick's house is the first person to figure out the swap?
Which member of the Parker household senses straight away that "Hallie" isn't really Hallie?
What does Hallie heat with a match before piercing Annie's ear?
What does Hallie hold behind Annie's earlobe when she pushes the needle through?
In which city do Nick and Elizabeth see each other again for the first time in 11 years?
How does Nick get to London before Elizabeth at the end?
Who says it? "Don't look at me. I don't know a thing."
300: Which poker hand does Hallie win with?
A royal flush
Which hand does Annie lose the poker game with?
A straight in diamonds
The loser of the poker game has to jump into the lake how?
Naked ("butt naked")
On the camping trip, which animal do the twins put on Meredith's water bottle?
A lizard
What do the twins secretly load into Meredith's backpack?
Rocks
To keep "mountain lions" away, what do the twins tell Meredith to do?
Bang two sticks together
Who in London catches Hallie on the phone with Annie and works out the swap?
Their grandfather (Charles)
Where do the twins set up a candlelit dinner to recreate the night their parents met?
On a yacht
Who serve the parents at that dinner?
Chessy and Martin
What happens to Nick when he first sees Elizabeth again at the hotel?
He falls into the swimming pool
What is Meredith's job?
Publicist (she does PR for Nick's vineyard)
How old is Meredith?
Who says it? "Sure you'll help me. Right over a cliff you'll help me."
Meredith (on the camping trip)
Who says it? "Maybe you'll actually find someone on this continent who can whip your tush at poker."
Martin (giving Annie a deck of cards)
Who says it? "So, how exactly are we paying for this?"
Nick (at the yacht dinner)
At the very end, who proposes to Chessy?
Martin
400: On what date is the twins' birthday?
11 October
What is Nick's vineyard estate called?
Parker Knoll
What does Meredith take before going to sleep on the night of the air-mattress prank?
A sleeping pill
What is the twins' grandfather's first name?
Charles
What is the name of the woman who runs Camp Walden?
Marva Kulp (Sr.)
What is the camp director's daughter called?
Marva Kulp Jr.
Which Nat King Cole song plays over the parents' wedding at the start?
"L-O-V-E"
In which year did Nick and Elizabeth get married, according to the opening?
During the camp prank war, a cabin is booby-trapped. What covers the counsellors when they pull the ceiling fan cord?
Feathers
In the same booby-trapped cabin, what pours onto the counsellors' heads from a bucket?
Chocolate syrup
How old are the twins during the summer at camp?
Who says it? "6 pounds, 11 ounces, 21 inches long."
Chessy (about the day "Hallie" came home from hospital)
Who says it? "Got on my very first 747, and you didn't come after me."
Elizabeth (to Nick at the yacht dinner)
Who says it? "Who are you, Robert De Niro?"
Meredith
Who says it? "Sun block, lip balm, insect repellent, stationery, stamps…"
Martin (packing Annie off to camp)
Before the swap, what does Hallie have to learn so Martin won't suspect a thing?
Annie and Martin's secret handshake
500: The story comes from a German children's novel. What is it called?
Das doppelte Lottchen (Lisa and Lottie)
Who wrote that novel?
Erich Kästner
Who says it? "This is beyond coincidence, this is beyond imagination!"
Annie (in the Isolation Cabin)
Who says it? "I knew I always liked her!"
Chessy (about Elizabeth)
Who says it? "First change I make is to send that two-faced little brat off to boarding school in Timbuktu."
Meredith
Who calls Annie "Queen of my heart"?
Martin
Who says it? "Excellent." … "Even more excellent."
Annie (agreeing to the poker bet)
Who says it? "I know how to fence and you don't."
Annie (to Hallie)
Which twin already had pierced ears before camp?
Hallie
Before piercing Annie's ear, what does Hallie have her hold behind it first?
An ice cube
What gets the twins sent to the Isolation Cabin?
The counsellors fall into one of Hallie's booby traps
What does Martin give Annie when he drops her off at camp?
A brand-new deck of cards
Name one move in Annie and Martin's secret handshake.
Any of: a bum bump, a wave under the chin, a shimmy
The twins' grandfather Charles is whose father?
Elizabeth's
What finally makes Nick call off his engagement to Meredith?
Her "It's me or them" ultimatum after the air-mattress prank
Who flies with Hallie from London to California?
Elizabeth (her mother)
